notes.title: Daily missions coming in Update 4.4!
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/327d7a74c15752071322017a38b217a8e908e51f.pngAwesomenauts 4.4 is right around the corner! This action-packed update will go into Beta next week, on September 20th, and we've already revealed the first couple of features that are included on the Streamisho!
Daily Missions - Starting in Update 4.4, you'll receive a new mission every day. These missions challenge you to play or win a certain number of games, play certain game modes, try out different characters from a specific roster, and more. Completing a mission will earn you a sweet Awesomepoint bonus. For new players, these missions will be aimed at helping them understand and explore what Awesomenauts has to offer, while more experienced players will receive missions that focus on winning matches!http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/116275d0e47dfcdcfa8de596d96fd54e8c3928cf.png
Overhauled main menu - We're giving the main menu a new lick of paint! Once you log in after Awesomenauts 4.4 has gone live, you'll notice that the main menu not only lists your currently active missions, but a bunch of additional tiles also highlight your recent accomplishments, milestones you're close to completing, and various other aspects of the game worth highlighting!http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/bad65530fc20987f6c31eef37dad346d3b6c107a.png
New modding features! - The modding community continues to create awesome new mods (like this awesome Ghostbusters mod by EgyptFalcon) and we want to provide them with the tools to make their mods even better! In Update 4.4, we're adding the ability to add custom particles to your mods, as well as change turret settings. Want to create a turret that shoots Derpl nukes? Now you can! Want to create a cool mod where a turret shoots at players to heal them? Say no more! We've got you covered!

Interested in how all of this looks in practice? Catch the VOD for the Streamisho! https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=G4DQSMoPIGc And that's not all! The biggest feature we're adding in the update is still a secret! Come back next week to learn all about the update and try it out in the Open Beta for yourself!http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/83112268dd181c322a847536fbabbed7fa9b3b2b.jpg

notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/e1d450f69e07c17946d5e6546ad59114d8e34a04.pngAs we announced last week, we'll be celebrating the fifth anniversary of Awesomenauts on Steam throughout the month of August. We launched the first weekend event last Thursday, but that was just first step! Every weekend throughout the month you'll be able to enjoy a quadruple First win of the Day bonus!

Additionally, log in during the remaining weekends this month and you'll get a different free skin every week. It's yours to keep, forever!

Finally, as we head to Cologne ourselves to participate in Gamescom with our biggest booth ever, you'll be able to access every 'Naut in the game for a full week to experience the full Awesomenauts cast for free! This event will start on Augusts 21st, and last all the way through August 27th!

Thanks again for all your support over the last couple of years, and we hope you'll join us for these celebrations throughout the month!

notes.title: Awesomenauts 4.2.1 - Hotfix live!
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/9f8c73f6f85e9820436ef89fd97b79e31d138a5d.png
We just released Awesomenauts 4.2.1, a hotfix for the recently-released 4.2 update! This update adresses some bugs related character skills, upgrades, and other issues!

Thanks to everyone who reported issues and provided feedback on the recent changes. Please continue to let us know what you think of Smiles  Catch the patch notes below:

Update 4.2.1 hotfix

General
Using a controller no longer results in selecting five different buttons in the dropdown from the main menu screen. 
Fixed that you couldn’t select the announcer dropdown in the in-game pause screen with a controller.

https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Sk%C3%B8lldir_001.jpg
Skølldir
Fixed that 3rd punch was unable to damage structures.

https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Smiles_001.jpg
Smiles
Released in a slightly too powerful state, some changes to tone down his problematic Trapper’s Hook skill

notes.title: AWESOMENAUTS 4.2 - OUT NOW
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/c6427cfa411bf19c5a69138c86a74b0d274860ae.pngAwesomenauts 4.2: Fired Up! is available NOW on Steam! A new character, new portraits, and a huge amount of improvements! Play now and take out Smiles for a spin! If you already own the All Nauts Pack, Smiles will be automatically unlocked for you!

Don't have the All Nauts pack yet? No worries! You can also unlock him with Awesomepoints if you've been saving up!

The latest update is the second one we're releasing this summer and there's a lot more coming up! Stay tuned for more news about awesome content launching beyond Update 4.2!

In addition to Smiles joining the Awesomenauts, we're also releasing a pretty awesome skin for him. Check out Pyromancer Smiles! http://store.steampowered.com/app/497621
Catch the full patch notes below!

Update 4.2
12-7-2017

NEW Naut: Smiles
Skills:
Trappers Hook: Throw out a hook that will drag enemy Awesomenauts towards you for a short duration.
Tail Whip: Smack your enemies with your steel stail, knocking them away.
Bush Fire: Use your flamethrower to burn everyone in a line.

Short backstory:
After he and the other renegades escaped from prison, Smiles hid in the swamps on Ribbit II. With a background of tracking and capturing targets, he put his skills to good use. The unorthodox method of poaching swamp rodents with his flame thrower, resulted in heavily burned pelts and hides, but it turned out a great business success as the dark charred bags were an instant hit on the amphibian black market. One day an old friend knocked on his door with a plan of vengeance. Step 1: join the Awesomenauts!

NEW skin: Pyromancer Smiles
Some crocodiles just want to watch the world burn. Pyromancer Smiles won't settle for that. He has peered into the flames and had visions of him setting all of creation ablaze! He's left the (now scorched) swamps of Ribbit II on a quest to fulfill this dark destiny, and stowed away on the Awesomenauts vessel to visit distant worlds. What's left standing after a battle is incinerated by the Pyromancer, until only ash remains.

He's dark, he's angry, and he's armed with a flamethrower. Don't cross Pyromancer Smiles as he'll burn you to a crisp! The Flames command it!

NEW: added portraitsFire commander
Ice commander
Love commander
Team power
The collection
Hairy King

GeneralThe scoreboard now tracks damage done to the base together with the damage done to turrets.
Opening the shop while having the scoreboard open will now open the shop and close the scoreboard, just as it was before 4.0.
Fixed that sometimes after closing the Steam overlay and pressing enter to chat, it would register as a shift+enter instead, opening all chat instead of team chat.
Fixed that if you moved the mouse very close to the centre of Coco and used her AA, her arms would extend in a different direction than her attack.
There is a new, more streamlined tutorial flow for new players.
Fixed that running on 1280x1024 or using the Screen Adjustment feature would cut off parts of the in-game HUD.
Steam IDs are no longer logged while in character select, fixing that players could figure out who they were going to play against before the match actually started.
Fixed that practice games could be joined via chat, for a short period.
Fixed that banned players wouldn’t get a ‘cancelled’ notification when trying to queue

AchievementsFixed that (some) counters for achievements would not update for some players.
Fixed that the Slowwolf announcer would not be granted to a player that got the “Welcome back!” achievement in a beta.

MenusFixed that League 1 didn't exist for some older seasons in the leaderboad history.
Depth issue fix for character icons in menus on Mac.
Fixed that it was possible to get stuck in a state where all buttons in the Play menu are locked after trying to join a custom game of which the last slot was just taken by another player.
Fixed an issue where clicking multiple times on a character profile picture in a lobby would result in an endless growing tooltip.
The tooltip about the items that you can buy now correctly states level 3 instead of level 4 at which you have unlocked all items.

SoundOptimised all sounds to use less space on disk and in memory and to load a bit quicker.
The “test voice” button in the Armory now correctly plays voice lines of premium skins.
Announcer voices and player-triggered character voices are now better audible.

BotsUpdated Veanko’s Leon, Lonestar, Raelynn, Gnaw, Skree, Clunk and Ayla bots

ModdingAdded a new option to AffectAreas to change a player’s team. This can for example be used to make mods where six players are in a single team or where you need to switch team during the mod. It is also possible to play local versus this way if only one of the local players switches team. This is an experimental feature that probably has a lot of issues, use at your own risk. For example, the deathtimers are disabled once this is used and switching to a team that doesn’t have graphics for the current class produces broken graphics (like a neutral team Lonestar). This feature might even be removed in the final release of 4.2 if we deem it too risky for final release.
Added an option to Button to only react to a specific character class.
Added automatic backup to the map editor (once every two minutes and when exiting the editing session).
Added an option to the AIDebugger (the F4 editor) to view detailed events about character gameplay. There is also an option to filter these events and to show them only for the selected character.
Fixed a crash when using the WriteToTextbox AI block in combination with zero respawn time or switchClass/switchTeam.
Fixed that actions and conditions weren’t sorted alphabetically in the BehaviourCreator tool.
Fixed that AffectAreas, JumpPads and Shops didn’t become invisible in the editor when the “Gameplay objects” group was hidden.

Thanks
For almost all of our updates since launch we’ve received extensive help from the community to discuss and point out balance issues and bugs. As always, we’re grateful for your input and we would hereby like to start highlighting community members for their efforts.

For this update in particular we say thanks to community members Gameinsky, Doppelganger, Sam! And Wakkabanana for their input, active Discord presence and willingness to provide input upon a wide range of balance topics.

notes.title: Awesomenauts 4.2: Fired Up! Launches July 12th!
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/9f8c73f6f85e9820436ef89fd97b79e31d138a5d.pngIf you didn't catch the Streamisho yesterday, you might have missed the news that Awesomenauts 4.2: Fired Up! will launch on July 12th! Rejoice!

The new update will contain Smiles, the flamethrower-wielding Renegade, an awesome Pyromancer Smiles skin, and some sweet new portraits! If you want to catch all the details, you can rewatch the full Streamisho on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=82GSJHJUXqIPYROMANCER SMILES
Some crocodiles just want to watch the world burn. Pyromancer Smiles won't settle for that. He won't stop until all of creation is set ablaze! He's dark, he's angry, and he's armed with a flamethrower. Don't cross Pyromancer Smiles as he'll burn you to a crisp!

The Pyromancer Smiles skin will come with unique voicelines and gives an ever darker twist to the angriest Renegade of the bunch! The skin will be available when Awesomenauts 4.2: Fired Up! launches next week!http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/9c2721c13ced869516060b3f49952437ff50f5f3.png
NEW MEDALS
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/3ff09e93e7bde68020a330f9b0292835e7d9dc84.jpg
With so many community events recently, we're adding in-game medals for accomplishments in these events in Update 4.2! How you earn them is up to the tournament hosts (with some limitations), so keep your eyes peeled for new community events in the coming weeks to learn more about how to earn these!

Are you hosting an event and want to give these away to particants? Get in touch with us through robin@ronimo-games.com!
NEW PROFILE PORTRAITShttp://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/d7da457e6727ae6c5a7f8e32770f224733a4ee1f.jpg
We're also adding a couple of sweet new portraits to the game with this update. We'll be revealing them in the week ahead, but you can already get a sneak peak at a new Giga Sentorii portrait above!
ROOKIE ROYALEhttp://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/aac2548bc6aed718be1560c8f0eaf1ccd373094d.png
The Rookie Royale came to a close last weekend, and it's been a great event overall. Thanks to all players who participated, were involved in coaching new players, made the event happen, and helped out with the on the shows! You guys are the best!

The Rookie Royale was an accessible tournament for players with little to no experience in the competitive community, where experienced players could coach them. We've seen a lot of new players compete, as well as many familiar faces from the community, and it's a blast overall!

Specifically, thanks to Alexeus, Slevens, Erabosu, Devmon, Uberransy, Body_Hunter, Skner, Pixelhat, Pasha, all the coaches, and everyone else who helped out behind the scenes!

Stay tuned for more events from the Awesomenauts League Project in the coming weeks.
KING OF THE FROGShttp://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/9a6549e4fd4bcad0cd26a8cdba333249ddc8eadf.jpg
Bets hosted a drop-in/drop-out King of the Frogs event right after the Streamisho, as a follow-up to the previous round of KotF two weeks back. Rather than go head-to-head as Froggy G, players faced off as Dizzy this week.

ART CONTEST BY REXIC
Community member Rexic hosted an art contest on the forums this week, challenging community artists to make summer-themed artwork based on Awesomenauts, with cash money as the prize! Thanks to Rexic for hosting this, because the submissions are AWESOME!

Lowgrasswhite won with an adorable piece of artwork featuring Coco and Nibbs, and it's just fantastic. Catch it below!http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/415113fa5059cc4ac53cb43295e3026ee86df615.png
If you want to check out all submissions, head over to the official Awesomenauts forums: http://www.awesomenauts.com/forum/viewtopic.php?f=12&t=50518

notes.title: 4.2 Beta update, Smiles theme, and community news!
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/3c2c9758991f3d6ec1e8cf61cb72c3a729f157fa.jpgThe second update for the Open Beta of Awesomenauts 4.2 went live yesterday, and there was a lot to discuss about the changes on the Streamisho. We’ll run you through all the news below but if you prefer, you can watch it on Youtube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2OsUyiLLGSM
Summer sale 
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/954656892a380d89c67f2eba32c4bb64c90e0c79.png
The Summer Sale has arrived! This year, the All Nauts Pack Summer Bundle is available on Steam. It contains the All Nauts Pack and all the three costume party DLCs. There are also discounts for skins, announcers, and costume parties. Be sure to check it out in the Armory!

4.2 Beta news
New changes were made to Awesomenauts and there were fixes for the level editor. Some balance changes are not final and might be reverted. The patch notes can be found here: http://steamcommunity.com/games/204300/announcements/detail/2533687504397152680
Smiles theme
Smiles, the newest addition to the Awesomenauts could be played in the Beta and his character theme had been unveiled in the Streamisho. Missed it? Listen to it on Youtube here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WIqpTWyJw-k&t=0s
Rookie Royale
The third qualifier of the Rookie Royale starts on the 1st of July. It’s an accessible tournament for new players. Sign-ups are still open until the 30th of June! More info here: http://www.awesomenauts.com/forum/viewtopic.php?f=6&t=50264

ALWB: King of the Frog
The King of the Frog is a casual drop-in/drop-out tournament that’s held over a longer time span. It is a custom 1v1 tournament with either Froggy G or Dizzy. Last week, it was possible to show your Froggy G skills and Dizzy battles can be fought out next week! Check out their discord more info: ALWB.ca/discord 

Community highlight
Are you up for a challenge with Nibbs? This custom map is designed to parkour around certain areas and complete the challenge!
Check out the Magic Dragon (Nibbs Parkour) by EgyptFalcon on the Steam workshop: http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=948499054

notes.title: Awesomenauts 4.2 - Fired Up! Open Beta Updated
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/b910166728c576bfba14aedc7c40507957bbed74.pngWe just updated the Open Beta for Awesomenauts 4.2: Fired Up! on Steam! Jump into the open beta to try out a whole bunch of tweaks to the new character, Smiles, as well as further experimental changes to Derpl, Yuri, and Ted McPain!

Full patch notes are below!http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/40bae42027a5c5ec0b961aa7174f3a7fcc2ad1bf.png
As always, please be aware that all changes in this open beta are subject to change, and your feedback plays an important role in helping to decide what makes it into the game and what needs further tuning.

Specifically the changes to Yuri, Derpl, and Ted McPain are currently subject to change and will likely return for further tweaks in betas for later updates.

For info on how to access the open beta, please visit our official forums.

Update 4.2 Beta 2
28-6-2017

General
Fixed that (some) counters for achievements would not update for some players.
Fixed that the Slowwolf announcer would not be granted to a player that got the “Welcome back!” achievement in a beta.
Fixed that the “Dinosaurs don’t like brain boxes” achievement would be granted if a player makes a kill after rejoining.
Made the sound ducking on announcer voices and player-triggered character voices more subtle.
Fixed that if you moved the mouse very close to the centre of Coco and used her AA, her arms would extend in a different direction than her attack.
Optimised all sounds to use less space on disk and in memory and to load a bit quicker.

Modding
Added an option to Button objects to only react to a specific character class.
Added an option to the AIDebugger (the F4 editor) to view detailed events about character gameplay. There is also an option to filter these events and to show them only for the selected character.
Fixed a crash when using the WriteToTextbox AI block in combination with zero respawn time or switchClass/switchTeam.
Fixed that actions and conditions weren’t sorted alphabetically in the BehaviourCreator tool.
Fixed that AffectAreas, JumpPads and Shops didn’t become invisible in the editor when the “Gameplay objects” group was hidden.

https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Ayla_001.jpg
Ayla
Rip-Apart Bear upgrade, self damage reduction increased from 18% to 25%.
Base Health, increased from 1350 to 1400.

https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Derpl_Zork_001.jpg
Derpl
Gave Derpl’s cats a moving tail for a better visual effect and feel.

https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Ix_the_Interloper_001.jpg
Ix
Prismatic Moonstone Dust upgrade, damage over time reduced from 110 to 90 per stage.

https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Smiles_001.jpg
Smiles
Bush Fire, damage against turrets reduced from 32 to 25 per flame.
Bush Fire, damage against droids increased from 21 to 25 per flame.
Trapper’s Hook, duration increased from 0.8s to 1.1s.
Trapper’s Hook, reeling in now takes 0.5s instead of 0.1s.
Tail Whip, added 0.2s of stun.
Unicornian Butt upgrade, stun increase reduced from 0.5s to 0.3s.
Warbot Heart upgrade, now also heals for 90.
Snapper Trap upgrade, price reduced from 215 to 175.
Snapper Trap upgrade, now heals for 250 upon landing Trapper’s Hook.
Candy Rope upgrade, now weakens affected enemies during the Hook for 20% for 160 solar.
My First Machete upgrade, slow increased from 10% to 12% per stage, duration increased from 1s to 2s, price increased from 145 to 160 per stage.
Inscribed Lighter upgrade, lifetime of flames increased from 1.3s to 2s, time between damage reduced to 0.4s.
Renegade walky talky upgrade, now shortens teleport to 1.5s when allies are near.

Highly Experimental, long term iterations

The changes listed below are experiments for you all to play around with and tell us what you think. Unless there’s a majority or proponents reached, these changes won’t make it into the upcoming update. The idea is for us to iterate upon these ideas until they might one day make it into the game.

https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Derpl_Zork_001.jpg
Derpl
Did some tweaks since last beta, trying to make tapping the trap button stick closer to the original behaviour. The trap now only flies out when fully charged
Grid Trap, if the skill isn’t fully charged, the Trap will be place at Derpl’s position.
Grid Trap, reduced the distance covered by fully charged Trap by 50%.
Fatcat upgrade, no longer affected by Longcat.

https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Ted_McPain_001.jpg
Ted McPain
A lot of players shun shotgun because it’s a bit clunky and the high-cooldown, high-damage aspect is easier to mess op than the continuous stream from machinegun. This experiment tries to make him play a bit smoother, stimulating more players to switch weapons more frequently. Last beta the damage wasn’t actually nerfed to compensate, these changes should bring the values more toward the original Ted.
Shotgun attack speed decreased from last beta by 20%.
Shotgun damage reduced by 20%.
Changed Stimpack and upgrades to fit with the changes above.
Stim pack attack speed increase replaced with a damage boost of 40%.
Ammo weekly attack speed increase replaced with a damage boost of 12% per stage.
Ted McPain Unicorn Dance Karting upgrade, damage per stage increased from 47 to 67.
Ted’s Power Briefs upgrade, shotgun knockback increase increased from 240% to 340%.

https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Yuri_001.jpg
Yuri
Iterating upon the ideas from the last beta, trying to remove old restrictions to make Yuri play a bit smoother while making it possible for veterans to keep their style. Additionally trying to add more depth through the charges mechanic of his laser.
Flight, initial jump increased by 30%.
Falling, allow Yuri to keep falling through glass platforms when Jetpack is off, by pressing down.
Ground acceleration and speed increased by 30%.
Laser, time between damage stages reduced from 1.2 to 0.7 seconds.
Laser, 3rd stage added to base, each stage adds 8 damage per tick.
Mine deploying, now limited to 2 mines. Creating a 3rd make the oldest explode.
Mine deploying, lifetime increased from 8 to 12 seconds.
Mine deploying, a hit indicator lets the Yuri player know if someone was hit by a mine.
Giant Monocle upgrade, range increase now starts at 10%, every damage stage adds 10%.
Resonance Amplifier upgrade, now adds 1 charge level, adding 8 damage.
Hubble’s Lens upgrade, now locks Yuri in place while firing and reduces time between charges from 0.7s to 0.3s.

notes.title: Awesomenauts 4.1 is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/d80afb2ae94c4bf169912230d17dc62231f8cc86.png
While everyone at E3 is focused on games shipping later this year or even in 2018, we're bringing you great new content TODAY! Awesomenauts 4.1: Dawn of the Renegades is available on Steam now! The best part is: everyone can enjoy Awesomenauts completely for free! This patch introduces a new character, brings additional gameplay improvements, adds additional level editor functionality, and much more!
 
Rocket’s Renegades are a group of mercenaries on the run from injustice, but they’re out for revenge! Dizzy is the first of them to join the Awesomenauts in this update. Commander Rocket, Smiles, and Qi’Tara will be joining in updates later this summer! Here is the trailer introducing all four of the Renegades: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=d5p5DFP40Fw  
Dizzy is a swift character that has the ability to dash multiple times. She can also leave a water-clone that explodes and hits all foes in the vicinity! Dizzy can be bought with Awesomepoints or will be available instantly for All Nauts Pack-owners.
 
Two new skins!

Bullbarian Deadlift
The long awaited skin for this Bovinion is now here! Meet the brutal Bullbarian Deadlift! Show off your greatsword when playing on the red team and an astonishing axe when playing on the blue team!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/2aa7bc0c429e3ed53cab349924fc10ad11e3d990.pnghttp://store.steampowered.com/app/557003Kunoichi Dizzy
After three gruelling years in the Waxxon Spiral, Dizzy completed her Aqua-Fu training. She had become Kunoichi Dizzy, Master of the Aqua-Fu!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/fec69d8061496b194d557f3f8db3233e318a554f.pnghttp://store.steampowered.com/app/634010/Awesomenauts__Kunoichi_Dizzy_Skin/
Switching classes
Mod creators are now able to use mechanics that switch you to other‘Nauts and skins in custom maps. It is even possible to play as a creep or droid, if you want! This gives new options for creative game modes, and we can’t wait to see what crazy stuff our community members will make! Check out this small video about the feature. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xigvHbNIy7M
New medals
We’re also adding a new series of in-game medals for players who manage to attain over 250 wins with a character! These are meant to show off the accomplishments of some our most dedicated players, who have been part of our community for years.
 
Looking ahead

notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/6a68cd2167999fddccab5703a4526254c31fee54.pngWe just released a hotfix for Awesomenauts that addresses a couple of issues players have encountered over the last week. This includes fixes for the issue where players would be stuck in the queue at 0:00, the SlowWolf announcer not unlocking as intended, and other connectivity issues.

Catch the patch notes below for the full details on the issues that have been addressed. Please continue to let us know if you happen to run into  problems over on the official tech support forums: http://www.awesomenauts.com/forum/viewforum.php?f=13

Update 4.0.6
1-6-2017
 
GeneralFixed a bug that caused players to get stuck in the matchmaker queue at time 0:00
Fixed a bug that caused players get stuck in a party that didn’t allow them to play at all.
Fixed a bug that caused the matchmaker to go down altogether in very rare cases.
Fixed that sometimes the Slowwolf announcer would not unlock.
Fixed that for some people, not all prestige medals would be unlocked.
Fixed that sometimes random announcer would result in no announcer at all.
Invite suggestions will only show players who are in global chat.
Fixed that the "Attack of the botanic Army!" achievement often didn't count the Weedlings you placed, and sometimes counted Weedlings you didn't place.
Fixed that the game would reset last selected skins on startup.
On first startup, the game language will now be determined by the language used in steam, instead of always defaulting to English for new users.
To fix the massive recruitment code spam in global chat users can no longer post their recruitment code in global chat. Recruitment codes can still be shared via party or team chat or outside of the game.
Global chat will block users from sending the same message within a short time period.
Fixed the win streak statistic on the stats screen.

notes.title: Meet Rocket's Renegades - Dizzy now in Beta!
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/cc9f8ba1c7e7b835eadfc4f3a158deff824a1858.jpgMeet: Rocket's Renegades! Commander Rocket, Qi'Tara, Smiles, and Dizzy have been on the run for years and are finally ready to face the ghosts that haunt their past... and they're doing that by joining the Awesomenauts!

Learn more about this crew in the trailer below: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=d5p5DFP40Fw Dizzy is the first Renegade to enlist with the Awesomenauts, and she is now available in the open beta for Awesomenauts 4.1: Dawn of the Renegades! Her fellow Renegades will join the Awesomenauts in future updates, so stay tuned for more news on that!

To access the Beta for Update 4.1: Dawn of the Renegades, follow the steps below:Right-click Awesomenauts in your Steam Library and select "Properties"
Select the "DLC" tab and make sure "Awesomenauts - Beta dual-load" is checked.
Wait until the beta is downloaded (this can take a while).
Start the game
Select "Play Awesomenauts Beta" and hit "PLAY"

On top of this brand new character, Update 4.1: Dawn of the Renegades also contains significant reworks for Derpl Zork and Yuri, as well as a huge array of balance changes. Catch the full patch notes below, but please note that these are subject to change ahead of the official release of Update 4.1

Please share your feedback on the Beta forum over on Awesomenauts.com: http://www.awesomenauts.com/forum/viewforum.php?f=19

Update 4.1 Beta 1
31-5-2017
 
NEW Naut: Dizzy
Skills:
Multi Dash: Save up to 3 dashes to unleash unto your enemies.
Explosive Clone: Leave a water clone at your location that explodes and deals damage in an area.
Bubble Shot: Fire a fast-moving bubble that deals damage.
 
Short backstory:
Using her mastery in Aqua-fu, Dizzy fooled the Scarg prison guards with her water clones and escaped along with her team. After being separated, she went back to her home planet to revitalize her singing career. There she formed a girl band called “the Dizzies” together with her water clones and conquered the Universal Music Charts in no time. A popularity poll showed that one of her clones was more popular than her, causing her to go on a graffiti spraying rampage. After being calmed by her old friends, she joins them into joining the Awesomenauts!
 
General
You can now try out skins in the armory
Added sound to the Solar shower in the testmap (the map where you can try out Nauts).
Tweaked when announcers will count down. For instance, it won’t count down in the test level in the armory anymore.
 
Map editor
Added two new options to AffectAreas: switchToClass and switchToSkinIndex. These allow you to swap which character and skin the player uses. This can even be used to switch to characters that are normally not playable, like droids and creeps. Note that a player can only be switched to a class or skin he or she owns. When switching to a class you don’t own, nothing happens. When switching to a skin you don’t own while you do own the class, you instead switch to the default looks of that Naut.
 
https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Ayla_001.jpg
Ayla
Quality of life change and changing/buffing unpopular upgrades.
Evil eye can now be shot when using rage. Rage will automatically turn off when using evil eye.
Angry Drawings, reduced price from 250 to 220 solar per stage.
Jail Food, increased damage over time from 105 to 135 per stage.
Jail Food, reduced price from 215 to 200 solar per stage.
Rubberband Ball, changed to a damage over time on the blood trail for 140 damage over 2 seconds.
Rubberband Ball, increased price from 150 to 200 solar.
 
https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Clunk_001.jpg
Clunk

notes.title: Meet Rocket's Renegades - Dizzy now in Beta!
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/cc9f8ba1c7e7b835eadfc4f3a158deff824a1858.jpgMeet: Rocket's Renegades! Commander Rocket, Qi'Tara, Smiles, and Dizzy have been on the run for years and are finally ready to face the ghosts that haunt their past... and they're doing that by joining the Awesomenauts!

Learn more about this crew in the trailer below: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=d5p5DFP40Fw Dizzy is the first Renegade to enlist with the Awesomenauts, and she is now available in the open beta for Awesomenauts 4.1: Dawn of the Renegades! Her fellow Renegades will join the Awesomenauts in future updates, so stay tuned for more news on that!

To access the Beta for Update 4.1: Dawn of the Renegades, follow the steps below:Right-click Awesomenauts in your Steam Library and select "Properties"
Select the "DLC" tab and make sure "Awesomenauts - Beta dual-load" is checked.
Wait until the beta is downloaded (this can take a while).
Start the game
Select "Play Awesomenauts Beta" and hit "PLAY"

On top of this brand new character, Update 4.1: Dawn of the Renegades also contains significant reworks for Derpl Zork and Yuri, as well as a huge array of balance changes. Catch the full patch notes below, but please note that these are subject to change ahead of the official release of Update 4.1

Please share your feedback on the Beta forum over on Awesomenauts.com: http://www.awesomenauts.com/forum/viewforum.php?f=19

Update 4.1 Beta 1
31-5-2017
 
NEW Naut: Dizzy
Skills:
Multi Dash: Save up to 3 dashes to unleash unto your enemies.
Explosive Clone: Leave a water clone at your location that explodes and deals damage in an area.
Bubble Shot: Fire a fast-moving bubble that deals damage.
 
Short backstory:
Using her mastery in Aqua-fu, Dizzy fooled the Scarg prison guards with her water clones and escaped along with her team. After being separated, she went back to her home planet to revitalize her singing career. There she formed a girl band called “the Dizzies” together with her water clones and conquered the Universal Music Charts in no time. A popularity poll showed that one of her clones was more popular than her, causing her to go on a graffiti spraying rampage. After being calmed by her old friends, she joins them into joining the Awesomenauts!
 
General
You can now try out skins in the armory
Added sound to the Solar shower in the testmap (the map where you can try out Nauts).
Tweaked when announcers will count down. For instance, it won’t count down in the test level in the armory anymore.
 
Map editor
Added two new options to AffectAreas: switchToClass and switchToSkinIndex. These allow you to swap which character and skin the player uses. This can even be used to switch to characters that are normally not playable, like droids and creeps. Note that a player can only be switched to a class or skin he or she owns. When switching to a class you don’t own, nothing happens. When switching to a skin you don’t own while you do own the class, you instead switch to the default looks of that Naut.

notes.title: Teasers, updates, and new tournaments!
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/d3643ed15f32364fe616acb48439d3b80802d383.png
Yesterday marked the last Streamisho before Awesomenauts goes Free-to-Play! The launch of Awesomenauts 4.0 will be on May 24th and a lot of news was announced before the big release. We will cover the news below, but you can watch the VOD here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uwhZSp7-_G8
Update 4.0.3 
In this update, which launched earlier this week, we improved the scoreboard based on community feedback and we will continue to iterate further to make it even more awesome!

Ammo bars were added for characters that use ammo-mechanics and the new visual help notifications for skills can be enabled/disabled in the settings. Check out the full patch notes here: http://www.awesomenauts.com/forum/viewtopic.php?f=6&t=49979 

Reddit AMA
We will be doing a Reddit AMA today (May 18th) at 17:00 EU (the same time as the start of the Streamisho). Here is the countdown timer, if you're not sure about when to tune in: http://buff.ly/2qrgaHC

The AMA can be found on: https://www.reddit.com/r/IAmA/
Have your burning questions ready!

New ‘Naut
An old newspaper was flying around in space and the readers discovered that a group of space mercenaries escaped from prison on Carcaco back in 3584! The new ‘Naut joining the game in Update 4.1 might have something to do with their breakout!http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/6f387a6c6ff7bd82ff897bd34643a83cd5073ea6.png
Community news

ALP
The Awesomenauts League Project announced that there will be 3 events coming soon! Rookie Royale, Console Clash, and The Showcase were all announced during the stream. The sign-ups for the Console Clash and the Rookie Royale will start May 20th and May 24th respectively.

Check out this forum post for updated information on the announced tourrnaments:
http://www.awesomenauts.com/forum/viewtopic.php?f=6&t=47140&start=20 

Awesomenauts Rumble
The Awesomenauts Rumble: Gathers May edition will kick-off on the 20th of May with the Qualifiers and the Playoffs are live on May 21st! Both streams will start 12PM EDT on www.twitch.tv/awesomenautsrumble 

Workshop highlight
In Squadnauts! by CationF, every player will spawn with the same ‘Nauts following them (Lonestars spawn Lonestars, Clunks spawn Clunks, etc).
They have a special custom AI and will follow you wherever you go, meaning you can have huge battles with lots of characters on screen!
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=921941322

notes.title: Update 4.0.4 - Now Live!
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/65518697327da94de7137c81c14b30ce65adb1c4.png
We just released update 4.0.4, an important update that helps us prepare our servers for the free-to-play launch on May 24th! This update contains some complex new features for our matchmaking system, though if everything works as intended you likely won't notice anything has changed.

We'll continue to monitor the performance of these systems over the coming days!

Full patch notes for this update are included below:

Update 4.0.4
18-5-2017

Made changes so that our servers can handle much larger numbers of simultaneous players once we go free to play. This contains some rather complicated tech so we expect we’ll be doing further fixes to this in the coming days.
Slightly increased the in-game scoreboard size.
Items bought icons are now always shown in the scoreboard when your account level is 6 or higher.
Fixed that you would sometimes still get invite suggestions when your party was already full.
Fixed that poor connection popup would appear partially behind other menus.
Fixed a rare crash while waiting for matchmaking.

notes.title: Awesomenauts 4.0.3 - Out Now!
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/65518697327da94de7137c81c14b30ce65adb1c4.pngWe just released update Awesomenauts 4.0.3, containing a brand-new droppod, tweaks to the in-game scoreboard, and tweaked match rewards!

Additionally, the launcher has been overhauled and should now only show once for all users on Mac and Windows! There are a lot of small tweaks that all polish up the experience, so check out the full patch notes below!

Update 4.0.3
16-5-2017

NEW: Zork Industries Mark II “Falling Closet” Droppod
This new droppod has been added to the Armory and is automatically unlocked for free for anyone that has played Awesomenauts before the free to play announcement (april 26th, 2017).
http://store.steampowered.com/app/605951
Scoreboard
The scoreboard layout has been overhauled. The new layout is more similar to the pre 4 iteration of the scoreboard.
Profile portraits are no longer displayed next to each entry, but on the medal tooltip.
Medals in the scoreboard now display the profile tooltip when hovered over
The end of game scoreboard now includes XP contribution.
NEW: ‘Skill Help’ option
Added the “Skill Help” setting in General Settings, which enables helpful visual indicators during gameplay for the following skills: Raelynn’s Snipe, Coco’s Ball Lighting, Derpl’s Nuke, Swiggins’ Anchor Drop, Sentry’s Teleport Beacon, Nibbs’ Orb of Omnicron, Ix’s Psionic Bond and Skree’s Saw Blade. This is enabled by default.
Launcher
The launcher has been visually overhauled (Windows and Mac only).
The launcher is now only shown the first time you start the game, or if you didn’t get into gameplay (since this may indicate a screen issue that requires the launcher to fix).
Tweaked XP and Awesomepoints rewards
XP and Awesomepoints rewards have been tweaked. Any previously received rewards have not been changed. The average Awesomepoints and XP gain per minute played has not changed for Online Match but has been significantly lowered for very short Co-op vs Bots matches.
The minimum length for a match to yield rewards has been lowered from 3 to 1 minute.
Awesomepoints and XP are now always gained per minute, with the first 4 minutes accumulating more points (even more if you win). This replaces the old large fixed amount + an amount that would accumulate over time beyond the 11 minute mark.
This new way of accumulating points now makes winning very short matches of Co-op vs Bots way less effective as it used to be and winning short Online Matches slightly less effective. Co-op vs Bots should now always be on par or slightly behind Online Match in terms of XP and Awesomepoints gain.
Depending on the duration of the match some matches might now yield more or less points than they used to. Generally, point accumulation has been smoothened out. Short matches (below 8 minutes) typically yield less to slightly less points. Average matches yield slightly more, and very long matches (30+ minutes) yield very slightly less.
The first win of the day bonus now always yields the same amount of points, when achieved.
Tutorial
Fixed an issue where in the training match a big stack of droids could be formed, if players stayed at the shop for too long.
Fixed that sometimes in the training match the other lane would be pushed entirely while the player wasn’t there.
General
Shielded damage is now hidden by default (there is a setting in General Settings to re-enable it). For example, 40 damage being reduced to 32 would previously show as “32🛡8” and will now show as “32🛡”, unless you re-enable the new option.
Mute/report menu now displays players’ chosen characters instead of their profile portrait.
Fixed that music after the first droppod sequence at the start of a match started too early (the first beat should coincide with the opening of the door).
Fixed a rare crash when a character died.
Fixed a crash when closing the game.
Fixed a rare crash that happened during the victory animation.
Fixed a crash when launching the game while Steam is not running.
Fixed a rare crash when uploading a replay fails.
Fixed that a small number was sometimes shown over the player character, in the middle of the screen during gameplay.
Fixed a rare issue where new players would not be able to start the tutorial (or any other mode) and would see an empty party in the main menu.
Added some decorations to the test map (where you can try Nauts from the Armory).
Menus
Fixed various glitches after playing the intro video, including the tutorial popup endlessly returning.
Fixed an issue with the text flipping out when the checkbox to hide the incognito popup was selected.
Medal slots and medals have different tooltips now in the profile unlock screen.
Fixed an issue where going back in the medal/portrait selection screen would hide the two progression counters in the profile menu as well as the global chat.
Returning from a specific naut in the armory to the armory browser will now open to the page where this last viewed Naut can be accessed.
The overview toggle button in the armory will remember the last chosen setting after you close the game.
Moved the portraits in the watch menu so they don’t drop off the right side of the screen.
Skins with special voices will now play during the end of match screen, instead of the normal voice line.
Changed the layout of the profile stats menu: Game mode selection has been moved to the bottom of the screen, while character name, and played/wins stats have been moved up.
Fixed a situation in which global chat would disappear.
Improved controller support in the menus.
Soundtrack DLC
Added an extended version of the music that plays during the droppod sequence at the start of a match.
Replays
Made some changes that hopefully fix the issue that replays of modded matches sometimes played on Ribbit instead of on the modded map (these changes should also fix this for already existing replays). Also added additional logging, so if you still have this issue then please send us your log files so we can analyse this issue further.
Fixed that character animations would often not play during the first few seconds after a character had spawned (only fixed for newly recorded replays).
Fixed that damage numbers in replays would often show 1 too low, so for example 31 instead of 32 (only fixed for newly recorded replays).
Fixed that Match of the day in the watch menu didn’t show the correct players for that match anymore.
https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Chucho_Krokk_001.jpg
Chucho Krokk
Improved visual clarity on Chucho’s sticky bomb timers by increasing the contrast a little.
https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Gnaw_001.jpg
Gnaw
Made the sound for Spit healing Weedlings more subtle.
Fixed that Gnaw would start with less parts when respawning after Bag of Seeds was bought.
Added an ammo bar for the current amount of parts and weedlings.
https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Jimmy_and_the_LUX5000_001.jpg
Jimmy and the LUX5000
Fixed that LUX Charge used sounds from Lonestar’s Bull.
Added a clearer visual indication for Lux’s ‘Danger pins’ upgrade.
https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Ksenia_001.jpg
Ksenia
Added Vanish skill voice-lines to Ksenia and Cosmic Captain Ksenia.
Added an ammo bar for the current amount of scissors.
https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Yoolip_001.jpg
Professor Yoolip
Fixed that the counter for Quark Microscope was missing from the HUD.
https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Raelynn_001.jpg
Raelynn
Improved Timerift collision handling, reducing the chance that it slides off a glass platform.
https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Sentry_X-58_001.jpg
Sentry
Added a small arrow pointing to an active Beacon.
https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Ted_McPain_001.jpg
Ted McPain
Added an ammo bar for the current amount of shotgun shells.
Modding
Fixed that AI editor could not expand ExecuteBehaviourTree blocks with modded AIs in them.
Teleporters can now be limited to only work creeps/humans/bots or to specific classes. Teleporters now also allow more control when limiting them by team.
AffectAreas can now be limited to only work on creeps/humans/bots and to specific classes.
Added option dontOffsetWithParallax to Particles objects.

notes.title: Beta keys, Founder Rewards, and community news!
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/d3643ed15f32364fe616acb48439d3b80802d383.png
We're getting closer to the release of Awesomenauts 4.0 and there is a lot of news to cover prior to the Free-to-Play release!

We’ll give you a full rundown of this week's news covered on the Streamisho  below. If you prefer to watch the Streamisho on Youtube, you can do so here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ved3xjMZ0jQ&
Beta keys
With the free-to-play launch of Awesomenauts 4.0 getting closer, we are giving out Beta keys in several ways. For now you can get Beta keys by signing up on our website, or on the MMO-Play website. Be sure to check out our social media channels for more Beta acces information!

New Founder Reward
We announced last week that we wanted to add another Founder Reward for the people that supported us for such a long time. Today we revealed that all founders will get the Mark II ‘Falling Closet’ droppod for free when it launches in 4.0.3 early next week! This droppod will also be available for purchase by non-founders.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/fa3475130f7114413580fdf7d7cc4f93db2cdadd.jpg

Reddit AMA
We will be doing a Reddit AMA on the 18th of May. AMA stands for Ask Me Anything, and a delegation of Ronimo Games will be online on Reddit to answer all your questions related to game development, Awesomenauts, or what color socks we are wearing! Details to be announced soon.

Community news

Guide contest
The guide contest started on the 2nd of May and anyone who owns a copy of Awesomenauts is eligible to participate in the contest. The contest runs until Wednesday, May 31st, 17:00 EU / 16:00 UK / 11 AM Eastern / 8 AM PT. Check out the announcement for extended information on the Guide Contest:
http://steamcommunity.com/games/204300/announcements/detail/1299695964251491198
Awesomenauts Rumble
The Awesomenauts Rumble team has opened sign-ups for the Gathers tournament in May. The Rumble team encourages everyone, experienced or new, to join the casual 3v3 tournament. More information on the Gathers tournament here: https://sites.google.com/awesomenautsrumble.com/home/gathers?authuser=0 

Be sure to check out the Awesomenauts Rumble: Scrim Show for competitive scrims and updates about their tournaments. Find them on: twitch.tv/awesomenautsrumble on the 11th of May, 18:00 CET, 17:00 UK, 12AM EDT, 9AM PT.

Workshop highlight
If you like custom maps, check out Ribbit V by Gnarlyman. It's a huge map with a lot of hide-areas, 12 turrets, and hidden shops!
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=921632195 
SlowWolf
Congratulations to Slow Wolf on hitting 200 episodes in your Let's Play series! Thanks for making so many Awesomenauts videos on Youtube. We've seen a lot of new people create videos on Youtube as well recently, and we love that. Thanks for helping us spread the word!

Check out SlowWolf’s channel for helpful Awesomenauts videos: https://www.youtube.com/slowwolfgaming

notes.title: 4.0 news, Founder Rewards, and offline mode!
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/d3643ed15f32364fe616acb48439d3b80802d383.png
Awesomenauts 4.0 has been out on Steam for over a week and we are happy to read about all the feedback you gave us. We’re using this feedback to make 4.0 even better, so please share your thoughts here on Steam or on the official forums!

We’ll give you a full rundown of all the news covered on the Streamisho this week below. If you prefer to watch the Streamisho on Youtube, you can do so here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6s73jBDe_bQ
Offline mode
We’ve received quite a lot of feedback about the offline features of Awesomenauts over the last week. Some people think we've removed botmatches and splitscreen with the latest update, but that's not the case: you can still play with and against bots in Update 4.0, and you can still play local splitscreen multiplayer. The only change here is that you need to have an internet connection to start the game, since your unlocks are now stored in the cloud.

Based on feedback of players who want to play Awesomenauts when they don’t have any internet available at all, we've decided to permanently leave an offline-only version of Update 3.5 available on Steam. And the nice thing is: it's available already!

For the full announcement on offline mode, click here: http://steamcommunity.com/games/204300/announcements/detail/1307577930857326934 
New Founder Reward
You are a founder of Awesomenauts if you owned a copy of the base game on Steam before April 26th. We decided that we will add another Founder Reward for the people that supported us for such a long time. We have not announced what this reward will be, but this will be done on our social media channels in the near future. Be sure to keep an eye out!

Awesomenauts Rumble: Gathers
Cute Men, consisting of Niki, Ubi, and DaveW, won the April Gathers tournament! Cute Men took away the Grand Prize in an intense final against the Xipang Disciples. Congratulations on winning this edition of the Gathers tournament!

Be sure to check out the Awesomenauts Rumble: Scrim Show for competitive scrims and updates about their tournaments. Find them on: twitch.tv/awesomenautsrumble on the 4th of May, 18:00 CET, 17:00 UK, 12AM EST, 9AM PT.

Guide Contest
The guide contest started on the 2nd of May and anyone who owns a copy of Awesomenauts is eligible to participate in the contest. The contest runs until the Wednesday, May 31st, 17:00 EU / 16:00 UK / 11 AM Eastern / 8 AM PT. Check out the announcement for extended information on the Guide Contest:
http://steamcommunity.com/games/204300/announcements/detail/1299695964251491198

notes.title: A note on Offline Play
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/d3643ed15f32364fe616acb48439d3b80802d383.png
Hey everyone! We'd like to make a quick announcement regarding some of the discussions on offline play that we've seen in the community!

There seems to be a lot of misunderstanding regarding the ability to play offline in Awesomenauts. Some people think we've removed botmatches and splitscreen with the latest update, but that's not the case: you can still play with and against bots in Update 4.0, and you can still play local splitscreen multiplayer. The only change here is that you need to have an internet connection to start the game, since your unlocks are now stored in the cloud.

In addition, some players have told us they want to be able to play when they don't have access to the internet at all. To make sure those players won't lose any features that they previously had access to, we've decided to permanently leave an offline-only version of Update 3.5 available on Steam. And the nice thing is: it's available already!

You can get the offline version like this:
Right click Awesomenauts in your Steam library and go to Properties.
Go to the DLC tab.
Enable the DLC called "Awesomenauts - Beta dual-load PC" (or Mac or Linux depending on your platform).
When you now start the game you can play offline by selecting "Play Awesomenauts Beta".
We'll replace this with a permanent solution in a few weeks, since future betas will overwrite your ability to access this particular version of the game. Once the way to access the offline version of Awesomenauts changes and we have the permanent solution ready for you, we'll let you know!

For now, enjoy!

notes.title: The Awesomenauts Guide Contest has started!
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/5ad94af9b82dab85943a028ccd942952acc97562.png
Hey there, as we hope you’ve heard: Awesomenauts will be going free to play on May 24th. Lots of new players will be playing Awesomenauts for the first time after the transition, and we look forward to welcoming them to our community and hearing from them. 

In order to help them learn more about Awesomenauts, we'd like to invite all existing players, our grizzled veterans, to participate in our brand new Guide Contest!

Write great guides, help new players, win awesome prizes! It’s that easy! Your contribution will not only make it a little easier for new players to join the community, but it’ll also earn you more skilled teammates to fight alongside on the battlefield!

We’ve opened the window for guide submissions on Steam as of today! Everyone who owns a copy of Awesomenauts and abides by the rules is allowed to participate in the contest, which will run until Wednesday, May 31st, 17:00 EU / 16:00 UK / 11 AM Eastern / 8 AM PT.

Be sure to support guides you like by giving them an upvote, as the Grand Winner of this contest will be decided based on the number of upvotes a guide gets. You can check out all submissions here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/204300/guides/

We encourage everyone to submit a cool Awesomenauts game guide to help new players learn more about Awesomenauts. The topic of your guide is up to you, and everyone is welcome to join the contest as long as they follow the rules below!

Rules:
There are no restrictions on creating guide for specific game modes, Awesomenauts, maps, or any other features
All the guides must be uploaded under the Awesomenauts guide section on Steam, and have [CONTEST] in their name. This tag may be removed after the contest ends
While there's no restriction on language for this contest, creating a guide in English (or translating to multiple languages) might help gain yourself more upvotes, as it potentially reaches a bigger audience.
The guide content must be created by yourself
Only 1 creator is allowed per guide
Several guides of one creator are allowed
All the guides must include relevant thumbnails, adding additional images to support the guide is encouraged
Only guides that are created after April 26th are eligible for the contest
Content in the guide has to be relevant for the current version of Awesomenauts
The guide with the most upvotes in the end wins the contest
There are other prizes for honorable mentions
Ronimo holds the right to disqualify a guide from the competition, if they conflict with any rule of the contest or the EULA

Winners will be announced on our Streamisho on May 31st, right after the window for submissions closes.
	 	 	
Prizes
Now, it’s time to announce the contest rewards! Go check the information below to see what you can win!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/e55532734c66067433a850a56c3fac95a29c7430.pnghttp://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/bc65f0d7180371570663e410b2f0b5e2cafba0a5.png
The Grand Winner
The creator of the guide with the highest number of upvotes wins a limited edition Clunk statue, all three Awesomenauts costume party DLC bundles, as well as an exclusive Roboscoop skin. On top of that, you receive the in-game Golden Gearlyfish medal.

Honorable mention
An honorable mention will be rewarded if we think a guide deserves a mention due to creativity, originality, overall value to the community, etc. All the honorable mention winners will get the exclusive Roboscoop skin and a Silver Gearlyfish badge!

Good luck with the competition, and may the best guide win!

notes.title: Awesomenauts 4.0.1 Now Live!
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/d3643ed15f32364fe616acb48439d3b80802d383.pngWe just released the first hotfix to Awesomenauts 4.0, including fixes for several gameplay issues and plenty of other improvements.

For more info on all the new features included in the 4.0 launch that released earlier this week, please check out the announcement we made on that.

Update 4.0.1

General

Fixed that turret health had been decreased by 20%. Turrets now have their correct health values back.
Fixed that you couldn’t chat during the victory/defeat screen.
Fixed that sometimes the Creeper Clunk Skin was incorrectly locked.
Reworked Slowwolf Announcer to hopefully fix that he sometimes didn’t unlock. If you had this problem then please let us know if it is fixed now.
Fixed that queue times for co-op vs bots were way too long. It’s now the intended 2 minutes. Note that co-op vs bots might have few players until we actually go free to play on May 24th.
Fixed that co-op vs bots matches used only one map (Ribbit IV).
Visually improved the droppod backgrounds for players with a Low background quality setting.
Fixed team colour and the neutral colour for the custom game bomb when using the ‘explode on death’ setting.
Improved visual clarity of the profile level 50 medal.
In the player status dock, the health of the blue team is now blue when colourblind mode is on.
When the game has trouble receiving end of game progress information, the game now waits for a maximum of 2 minutes after the game to retrieve that info and show you your rewards.

Progression
The XP needed to level your account from level 0 to 1 has been decreased from 480 to 315
The XP needed to level your account from level 1 to 2 has been increased from 495 to 550
The XP needed to level a character from level 0 to 1 has been decreased from 400 to 315

Menus
Fixed that featured matches didn’t show in the Watch menu.
Fixed some cases where global chat sometimes randomly disappeared (seems like it still happens sometimes, let us know if this happens to you and in what situation).
Recruitment code now correctly displays on Linux.
Fixed an issue where pressing back on controller in character select while matchmaking would cause the leave game popup to not be controllable for 5s.
Safe to leave message moved up so it isn’t blocked anymore by the exit menu button in the ingame menu.
When a naut is already unlocked it will not show the discount label anymore.
When you have selected a character that has less than a minute of total play time, the profile stats screen now shows “0” instead of displaying incorrect values for the “per minute” stat in each stat category.
Fixed that in some occasions the progression bar in the armory kept counting up and resetting.
Fixed that the tutorial character GG7 kept talking during popups that should silence him.
Fixed a typo in the prestige medal descriptions.

https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Chucho_Krokk_001.jpg
Chucho Krokk
Teamcolour is now being displayed properly on Chucho's sticky bomb.
The tiny sticky bomb, from the Trick-Up-Your-Sleeve upgrade, should now play it's entire animation instead of resetting after starting.

https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Gnaw_001.jpg
Gnaw
Fixed that fertilizing Weedlings would play the heal sound rapidly.

https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Jimmy_and_the_LUX5000_001.jpg
Jimmy and the LUX5000
Fixed that the Nano Repair Bots lifesteal would proc multiple times for multiple hit targets.

https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Sentry_X-58_001.jpg
Sentry
Activating Black Hole Sun will now always use the skin’s appropriate voice.

notes.title: Awesomenauts going free to play on May 24th!
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/d3643ed15f32364fe616acb48439d3b80802d383.png
It's really happening! Awesomenauts is going free to play on May 24th! Soon everyone can be an awesome space mercenary!
https://youtu.be/g4EV6KmsW58
Going free-to-play has always made sense for Awesomenauts, as more players simply means it’s a better game for everyone. It greatly improves the matchmaking and networking experience, and brings more people to community events and the amazing community-made mods.

We couldn't have done this without your support! Your continued feedback inspires us to dream big, and many of the changes we’re introducing with 4.0 are a direct result of that. Thanks to your support, Awesomenauts has grown from a scrappy indie title to one of the few enduring online games. And with your help we're going to launch Awesomenauts into the stratosphere!

Before we get down to talk about all the cool new stuff, we need to mention two very important things that will stay the same amidst all of these big changes:
Awesomenauts is still the platforming MOBA you know and love. Nothing changes to the gameplay.We won’t sell power. You can’t pay to win. Players won’t be able to spend real money to get an advantage during matches.So, with that out of the way: let's get down to all the cool new stuff in this update!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/34ced5c8ddd269a19bc99087c53bc0d81f001071.png
Existing Player rewards!
We couldn’t possibly have made this massive update without the support of all our awesome existing players! That’s why everyone who played Awesomenauts before April 26th will automatically be rewarded ‘Founder’ status, granting an exclusive portrait and medal! Of course, you'll also have a huge head start over all newcomers, as you will already have lots of characters unlocked!

Even better, if you own the base game plus both expansions before May 24th, you'll automatically be upgraded to the 'All Nauts Pack'! This grants you every 'Naut, forever.

And as always, your feedback remains essential! So don't hesitate to tell us what you think of all these changes.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/e79f2f97c206d59599c310d81147836506710df6.png
Portraits, Medals and Droppods
Custom Portraits, Droppods and Medals have been added to make sure there is plenty of cool stuff to unlock! To help show off these sweet new unlockables we've also taken the opportunity to completely overhaul the match intro and scoreboard. Not only does the new intro show off your Droppod, Medals and Portrait, it also gets everyone pumped to get started!
Portraits can be gained through normal progress, while Medals are rewarded for achieving special feats. Droppods on the other hand, are bought with the new currency: Awesomepoints!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/236845303585d50c839515a38e2058a9575d99a6.png
Level up your Profile and Nauts!
When playing matchmade games, both your Profile and played Naut will gain experience! And both of them can go up in level separately, granting you unique rewards. Items are now the first thing a 'Naut unlocks, which makes completing your build much faster. Levels will also get you Portraits, Awesomepoints and other goodies!

The Profile screen has also be revamped to hold all everything progress related. Here you'll find your stats, 'Naut progress, Medals and Portraits.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/b20525b15abd8334d298d95786c4d1c6acf62048.png
Awesomepoints are here!
On top of experience, playing will also get you Awesomepoints! These can be spent on unlocking any 'Nauts you don't own yet, or the new Droppods and Portraits. Every Awesomenaut can be unlocked this way, even if they were previously part of an expansion. There's also a new testing environment for 'Nauts you don't currently own yet, so you can try before you buy!

Real money is still the only way to buy the 'Naut skins, but can now also be used to buy individual 'Nauts and Droppods.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/57083ff37c02df44b2543a89e88abec06eed3308.png
Introducing the 'All Nauts Pack'
If you just want to have all 'Nauts available to you at all times, this Pack is for you. It not only gets you all current 'Nauts, but also all the new ones as they come out! The Pack will also grant 'Collector' status, giving you an exclusive Medal and Lonestar skin.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/7a45a45714f55783489028e2ef306a1de3f5458c.png
And as mentioned before, if you own the game plus both expansions before May 24th you will automatically be upgraded to the 'All Nauts Pack'! To help all our existing players upgrade to this Pack, we'll be discounting the expansions until the free-to-play launch.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/b65dbe9e2115a02aeb518f9eb221d178db6329ed.png
New game mode: Co-op vs. Bots!
Not feeling very competitive today? Team up with your fellow man and take down a team entirely comprised of Bots! When firing up this new mode you can pick you own difficulty, and Galactron will go look for allies with similar wishes and a low ping. Beating up the Bots will net you rewards just like the regular vs. Player mode, so no worries about missing out.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/94095a6daeb2aa27ebb957395d57071ff3ceffed.png
New menu: Armory!
Want to pick up some new Awesomenauts or Droppods? You need to be in the Armory! Here you can easily browse all the content you’ve unlocked so far. Every item can be digged into for more details, including backstories and splash art. In case of the characters there’s lots of info on their gameplay too, including their Shop items and skills. You can even take characters for a quick testdrive!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/752e1c92a05a64a6dddd62952b770502176aa54e.png
Recruit all the friends!
Reaching level 5 will grant you a special recruitment code, which you can give to any other players!

New players will be able to enter your key and unlock Raelynn, for free! Any player can only be recruited once!

Whenever a player that you have recruited reaches level 8, you will gain 1000 Awesomepoints! You may recruit up to 50 players this way.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/f3c708bbc1191726499ecda53b76ab2214069f52.png
Completely new tutorial!
To help all those new players get their bearings in Awesomenauts, we've completely overhauled the tutorial. It features a lot less player downtime and also explains every aspect of the game a lot more thoroughly. The first mission still features Sheriff Lonestar, but in the second players can give Scoop a whirl to learn all about pushing and staying alive.

All in all, there's a lot of awesome stuff in the new update, and there's even more to look forward to in the coming months.

Exciting times are coming, and we'd once again like to thank you for all the support you've given us over the years. We're excited about the future, and hope you'll join us on this next step in our adventure!

Thank you!

- Ronimo Games

The Profile screen has also be revamped to hold all everything progress related. Here you'll find your stats, 'Naut progress, Medals and Portraits.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/b20525b15abd8334d298d95786c4d1c6acf62048.png
Awesomepoints are here!
On top of experience, playing will also get you Awesomepoints! These can be spent on unlocking any 'Nauts you don't own yet, or the new Droppods and Portraits. Every Awesomenaut can be unlocked this way, even if they were previously part of an expansion. There's also a new testing environment for 'Nauts you don't currently own yet, so you can try before you buy!

Real money is still the only way to buy the 'Naut skins, but can now also be used to buy individual 'Nauts and Droppods.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/57083ff37c02df44b2543a89e88abec06eed3308.png
Introducing the 'All Nauts Pack'
If you just want to have all 'Nauts available to you at all times, this Pack is for you. It not only gets you all current 'Nauts, but also all the new ones as they come out! The Pack will also grant 'Collector' status, giving you an exclusive Medal and Lonestar skin.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/7a45a45714f55783489028e2ef306a1de3f5458c.png
And as mentioned before, if you own the game plus both expansions before May 24th you will automatically be upgraded to the 'All Nauts Pack'! To help all our existing players upgrade to this Pack, we'll be discounting the expansions until the free-to-play launch.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/b65dbe9e2115a02aeb518f9eb221d178db6329ed.png
New game mode: Co-op vs. Bots!
Not feeling very competitive today? Team up with your fellow man and take down a team entirely comprised of Bots! When firing up this new mode you can pick you own difficulty, and Galactron will go look for allies with similar wishes and a low ping. Beating up the Bots will net you rewards just like the regular vs. Player mode, so no worries about missing out.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/94095a6daeb2aa27ebb957395d57071ff3ceffed.png
New menu: Armory!
Want to pick up some new Awesomenauts or Droppods? You need to be in the Armory! Here you can easily browse all the content you’ve unlocked so far. Every item can be digged into for more details, including backstories and splash art. In case of the characters there’s lots of info on their gameplay too, including their Shop items and skills. You can even take characters for a quick testdrive!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/752e1c92a05a64a6dddd62952b770502176aa54e.png
Recruit all the friends!
Reaching level 5 will grant you a special recruitment code, which you can give to any other players!

New players will be able to enter your key and unlock Raelynn, for free! Any player can only be recruited once!

Whenever a player that you have recruited reaches level 8, you will gain 1000 Awesomepoints! You may recruit up to 50 players this way.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/f3c708bbc1191726499ecda53b76ab2214069f52.png
Completely new tutorial!
To help all those new players get their bearings in Awesomenauts, we've completely overhauled the tutorial. It features a lot less player downtime and also explains every aspect of the game a lot more thoroughly. The first mission still features Sheriff Lonestar, but in the second players can give Scoop a whirl to learn all about pushing and staying alive.

All in all, there's a lot of awesome stuff in the new update, and there's even more to look forward to in the coming months.

Exciting times are coming, and we'd once again like to thank you for all the support you've given us over the years. We're excited about the future, and hope you'll join us on this next step in our adventure!

Thank you!

- Ronimo Games

notes.title: Awesomenauts 4.0 date and contest maps!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/af53ff5eb8da951e7537f7cdd37a0c61b10646d7.png
This week’s Streamisho covered teaser images, community news, and level editor contest maps! We will cover everything you need to know here. If you want to watch the VOD, you can do so on Youtube here:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=A9nwrZKMF2Y
Kickstarter
Crowdfunding pledges closed on the 12th of April and this marks the end of the crowdfunding campaign that spanned over three and a half years. This campaign made Starstorm a reality, lead to the level editor, the custom game browser, and many other features! We would like to thank everybody who supported our campaign! 

Prestige
The current prestige system will be removed from the game on the 26th of April, so grab new levels while you can! 
The icons you get now from prestiging will remain available to you when this system is gone, so don’t worry about any of your accomplishments going to waste. Whatever we’re replacing the system with will allow you to flaunt the icons you’ve already unlocked!

Awesomenauts 4.0
The 26th of April will mark the reveal of a new Awesomenauts update! This will not be labelled as update 3.6 but 4.0! We have a lot of awesome stuff in store and will be revealing bits of the update on our social media channels in the coming weeks! The first thing we showed was something that looks like a Droppod! Be sure to keep an eye out on our social media channels this week and you might catch another sneak peak!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/e306c1b2f30aa2d13357d9f7f651337f9ac6b188.png

Contest maps
Almost all level editor contest maps have been showcased and discussed during the stream. There are 21 contest maps so far and the contest ends on the 19th of April at 17:00 EU time. The countdown timer can help you with submission deadlines here

We made a list with contest map submissions and will be updating the list, if people decide to submit maps in the final week! You can find the list here: https://steamcommunity.com/games/204300/announcements/detail/646671482195404464
